historical_record.description: The Ella Hill Hutch Community Center, created within the A-2 project area and named for the first Black woman to serve on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors. Identified in 2024 as eligible for local landmark, California Register or National Register designation.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.style: Late Modernism and Third Bay Tradition
historic_survey.note: The Ella Hill Hutch Community Center by Jenkins & Fleming, an African American-led firm - Late Modernist in its forms, inflected with the regional materiality of diagonal wood siding associated with the Third Bay Tradition.
